description:
The ancient Celts weren't the primitive barbarians Roman propaganda portrayed. Archaeological discoveries reveal sophisticated traders who built wealth on salt, skilled metalworkers who invented chainmail, and complex societies where women held real power. From Austrian salt mines to Yorkshire chariot burials, the evidence completely rewrites everything we thought we knew.
